name: Jagged Knife Kneebreaker
descr: An imposing brawler carrying a large club.

features.name: I've Got 'Em
features.text: Creatures _Restrained_ by the Kneebreaker take double damage from attacks by other adversaries.

features.name: Hold Them Down
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes no damage but is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_. The target can break free, clearing both conditions, with a successful Strength Roll or is freed automatically if the Kneebreaker takes Major or greater damage.
